facts.fact: ISS Africa lists the Central African Republic among six Central African countries with an internet shutdown recorded in 2025.
ISS Africa lists Cameroon among six Central African countries with an internet shutdown recorded in 2025.
ISS Africa lists the Democratic Republic of the Congo among six Central African countries with an internet shutdown recorded in 2025.
ISS Africa says an ad hoc internet shutdown occurred in Congo-Brazzaville during its March 2026 presidential polls.

ISS Africa says social media access in Gabon has been blocked since February 2026, cutting off at least 800,000 users from Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok; the government announced gradual lifting on 1 April but access remains hindered.
ISS Africa says Equatorial Guinea had a 14-month targeted internet shutdown on Annobon Island from August 2024.
ISS Africa says that since November 2024 mobile internet has been cut in Chad's Lake Province after a Boko Haram attack and the counter-offensive.
